asr_text: Researchers mapped over 8,900 moonquakes and estimated that its radius shrank 40 to 46 meters in a later period. This is not all its shrinking since the moon formed. A thick rock layer with many gaps may have slowed cooling and helped explain why models predict much more shrinking.
